subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Hermes the Guide
description: A quick win: understand Hermes the Guide.

hook.text: Hermes wore winged sandals and carried a golden staff. Among his many jobs: escorting the dead below.

buildup.text: As psychopomp, Hermes led souls to the river Styx. He was the last friendly face before the crossing.

discovery.text: Hermes moved between all worlds freely—Olympus, Earth, Hades. He was the god of thresholds and passages.

twist.text: He was also the god of thieves and tricksters. The same figure who guides the dead also deceives the living.

climax.text: Boundaries need guardians who belong to both sides. Hermes works at the borders of everything.

punchline.text: The guide between worlds trusts none of them.

quiz.question: What role did Hermes play regarding the dead?
options: He guided them to the underworld
